title: Workspace Surfaces Manifest
description: Manifest of workspace-owned surfaces, generated artifacts, and ownership roles.

items.description: One entry in the payload files list.

payload_files.description: Ordered payload files entries used by this contract.

necessary_surface_files.description: Package-owned files that remain installed in the necessary-surface profile.

necessary_surface_roots.description: Directory roots retained and synchronized as units in the necessary-surface profile.

memory.description: Installed host paths contributed by the memory module.

planning.description: Installed host paths contributed by the planning module.

verification.description: Installed host paths contributed by Verification; empty when its selected boundary remains repo-owned and explicitly optional.

module_surface_files.description: Installed host paths contributed by each selected module and added independently to closure cells.

modules.description: All listed modules must be selected for this reference to apply; an empty list applies to every combination.

required_references.description: Required references that must resolve in every selected installed footprint.

source_globs.description: Payload-relative globs whose matching text files are scanned for operational references.

installed_source_roots.description: Canonical source roots mapped onto installed paths before reference discovery.

generated_source_authorities.description: Runtime/code-generation authorities projected to installed sources whose references are not stored in payload files.

reference_discovery.description: Installed operational text surfaces scanned mechanically for file-like Agentic Workspace references.

installed-local.description: Resolution rule for paths installed into the host repository.

package-resource.description: Resolution rule for stable resources retained inside the installed package.

optional.description: Resolution rule for optional references with a declared degraded behavior.

reference_resolution.description: Canonical interpretation of installed reference kinds.

entrypoint.description: Installed executable used as the no-CLI fallback entrypoint.

policy.description: Installed machine-readable authority consumed by the executable fallback.

forbidden_actions.description: Canonical forbidden-action decisions that the executable fallback must return.

next_safe_action.description: Stable action returned when the installed CLI is unavailable.

no_cli_fallback.description: Content-level fallback boundary exercised from installed files with the CLI unavailable.

system_intent_mirror_kind.description: System intent mirror kind text value used by this contract.

subsystem_intent_kind.description: Subsystem intent set kind used by the editable scoped durable-intent store.

default_agents_path.description: Default agents path text value used by this contract.

items.description: One entry in the handoff surfaces list.

handoff_surfaces.description: Ordered handoff surfaces entries used by this contract.

planning.description: Planning text value used by this contract.

memory.description: Memory text value used by this contract.

additionalProperties.description: Named entry in the module upgrade source paths mapping.

module_upgrade_source_paths.description: Module upgrade source paths details used by this contract.

setup_findings_path.description: Setup findings path text value used by this contract.

proof_route_hints_path.description: Workspace-managed advisory proof route hints path.

items.description: One entry in the mixed agent local override fields list.

mixed_agent_local_override_fields.description: Ordered mixed agent local override fields entries used by this contract.
